inputs.text: The warning reveals what is really happening: the APC’s direction ahead of the 2027 elections is a deliberate effort to shut ordinary people out and reserve political influence for the wealthy. Calling it an accident or failing to scrutinize it only protects those who benefit. Democracy may remain on paper while moneyed interests decide who gets a voice and whose future counts.
